name: Default
shortDescription: Identity and access management platform with OIDC, SAML, passkeys and multi-tenancy, deployed with its login UI and PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in at https://<your-domain>/ui/console as zitadel-admin@zitadel.<your-domain> with the password stored in the ZITADEL_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable. That variable is only read on the first start; change the password later in the console. Configure SMTP in the console for email verification and password resets.

Zitadel binds its instance to the domain and HTTPS at first start. Serve it over HTTPS and do not change the domain or ZITADEL_MASTERKEY afterwards, or requests fail with "Instance not found" and encrypted data becomes unreadable.
